Symptoms analysis:
- Burning pain in stomach (epigastric pain)
- Gas and bloating
- Weight loss, loss of appetite
- Dark and tarry stools (melena - indicates upper GI bleeding)
- Blood in vomit (hematemesis - indicates upper GI bleeding)

These are classic signs of Peptic Ulcer Disease (PUD). PUD often presents with burning epigastric pain, nausea/vomiting (sometimes with blood), melena, and weight loss due to fear of eating or malabsorption.
